pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into losing positions; subsequent entries on the same asset require a minimum +$3.00 unhedged floating profit on the primary tranche.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Strict volatility-band filter: block all trades if ATR(14) exceeds 2.5x the 50-period average unless confirming breakout volume.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop locking at +$10.00 profit to ensure capture of the $15-$30+ target window.
